introduction: Lyrical story about love between two ordinary people over forty. They live in the same borough. He is a meteorologist who also has a side job translating technical literature. After the death of his wife he live alone with his son (in his late teens). She works in the field of culture and recreation. Divorced. Her daughter goes to the same grade as his son.Friends and co-workers have various opinions about their relationship, some approve it, others don't. Same thing could be said about the children, the boy, in particular, has hard time accepting the new situation.
